turns.did:
SELECT
  ARRAY_TO_STRING(
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(
        LEFT(color, 1),
        '[' || (
          ' 	
 ' || CHR(11) || '!"#$%&''()*+,\\\-./:;<=>?@\\\[\\\]\^_`{|}~'
        ) || ']'
      )
      THEN LIST_TRANSFORM(
        REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(
          color,
          '([' || (
            ' 	
 ' || CHR(11) || '!"#$%&''()*+,\\\-./:;<=>?@\\\[\\\]\^_`{|}~'
          ) || ']+|[^' || (
            ' 	
 ' || CHR(11) || '!"#$%&''()*+,\\\-./:;<=>?@\\\[\\\]\^_`{|}~'
          ) || ']+)'
        ),
        (seg, idx) -> CASE
          WHEN idx % 2 = 0
          THEN UPPER(LEFT(seg, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(seg, 2))
          ELSE seg
        END
      )
      ELSE LIST_TRANSFORM(
        REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(
          color,
          '([' || (
            ' 	
 ' || CHR(11) || '!"#$%&''()*+,\\\-./:;<=>?@\\\[\\\]\^_`{|}~'
          ) || ']+|[^' || (
            ' 	
 ' || CHR(11) || '!"#$%&''()*+,\\\-./:;<=>?@\\\[\\\]\^_`{|}~'
          ) || ']+)'
        ),
        (seg, idx) -> CASE
          WHEN idx % 2 = 1
          THEN UPPER(LEFT(seg, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(seg, 2))
          ELSE seg
        END
      )
    END,
    ''
  ) AS color
FROM contoso_served.dim_product
